payload.name: Changeover
payload.description: Planned product or tooling changeovers including setup, adjustment, and first article inspection time.

payload.name: Electrical Failure
payload.description: Electrical system failures including drives, PLCs, sensors, wiring, and power distribution issues.

payload.name: External
payload.description: External factors including customer holds, supplier issues, and regulatory stops.

payload.name: Material Issue
payload.description: Stoppages caused by material problems including shortages, wrong material, contamination, or material handling issues.

payload.name: Mechanical Failure
payload.description: Equipment failures related to mechanical components including motors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, chains, and structural elements.

payload.name: Operator
payload.description: Operator-related stoppages including breaks, meetings, training, and staffing shortages.

payload.name: Planned Maintenance
payload.description: Scheduled preventive maintenance activities including inspections, lubrication, and component replacement.

payload.name: Process Issue
payload.description: Process-related stoppages including recipe problems, parameter deviations, and process upsets.

payload.name: Quality Hold
payload.description: Production stops due to quality issues including out-of-spec product, inspection holds, and quality investigations.

payload.name: No Schedule
payload.description: No production scheduled including weekends, holidays, and unplanned idle time.

payload.name: Unplanned Maintenance
payload.description: Reactive maintenance activities triggered by equipment failures or degradation.

payload.name: Utilities
payload.description: Utility failures including compressed air, steam, water, nitrogen, and HVAC systems.
